questions.explain: The story suggests the world may not have been made by God.

questions.q: Which place did the explorer NOT visit?
questions.explain: The story mentions visiting Over The Hills, Across the Rivers, and Through The Forests but not Past the Cities.

questions.q: Why did the explorer say it was a beautiful world?
questions.explain: The story ends with 'It Is A Beautiful World! Over The Hills' suggesting a song is what made the world beautiful.
